# Vyomi: AZURE
# Well-known Azurite key; the simulator ignores SharedKey signatures. *.localtest.me resolves to 127.0.0.1.
AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING="DefaultEndpointsProtocol=http;AccountName=devstoreaccount1;AccountKey=Eby8vdM02xNOcqFlqUwJPLlmEtlCDXJ1OUzFT50uSRZ6IFsuFq2UVErCz4I6tq/K1SZFPTOtr/KBHBeksoGMGw==;BlobEndpoint=http://127.0.0.1:9000/devstoreaccount1;QueueEndpoint=http://devstoreaccount1.queue.localtest.me:9000;"
AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT=devstoreaccount1
# The only subscription a space has; any other id returns SubscriptionNotFound.
AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=00000000-0000-0000-0000-cloudlearn01
# Pass as the ARM base_url / $host / cloud.Configuration ResourceManager endpoint; any credential is accepted.
AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:9000
# Cosmos SDKs require TLS: goes through caddy :9443, trust its certificate.
AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT=https://127.0.0.1:9443/azure-data/cosmos/devstoreaccount1
AZURE_COSMOS_KEY=C2y6yDjf5/R+ob0N8A7Cgv30VRDJIWEHLM+4QDU5DE2nQ9nDuVTqobD4b8mGGyPMbIZnqyMsEcaGQy67XIw/Jw==
# Key Vault SDKs require TLS and rebuild paths from the host, so use the host-based form.
AZURE_KEYVAULT_URL=https://cloudlearn.vault.localtest.me:9443
notes: Service Bus: the simulator speaks the Service Bus REST protocol only. AMQP (the default transport of azure-servicebus / @azure/service-bus / azure-messaging-servicebus) is NOT supported; use REST send/receive under http://127.0.0.1:9000/azure-data/servicebus, or Azure Storage Queues for point-to-point.
Blob requests share :9000 with S3; the simulator routes them by the x-ms-version header, so keep the account as the first path segment.

config.ARM endpoint: set AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_HOSTNAME to the simulator host (e.g. 192.168.252.7:9000) — the simulator serves /subscriptions/... ARM routes
config.subscription: the space has one subscription, 00000000-0000-0000-0000-cloudlearn01 (GET /subscriptions returns it, as `az login` reads it); any other id is SubscriptionNotFound, as in Azure

cli.notes: Azure CLI dev usage in the simulator: point ARM at the simulator host. Real az CLI binaries work for any service whose ARM operation is implemented (covered by the 11 service packs in packs/azure/).

config.ClientOptions: arm.ClientOptions{ClientOptions: azcore.ClientOptions{Cloud: cloud.Configuration{Services: map[cloud.ServiceName]cloud.ServiceConfiguration{cloud.ResourceManager: {Endpoint: endpoint, Audience: endpoint}}}}}

go.dependency: github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/* (armcompute, armstorage, armsql, armservicebus, armcosmos, armappservice, armapimanagement, armnetwork, armeventgrid, armkeyvault, armauthorization)
help: Configure cloud.Configuration to point ResourceManager at the simulator base URL.
Real conformance test in tests/conformance/azure-sdk-go/ proves armcompute/armstorage/armsql/armservicebus/armcosmos round-trip.

config.credentials: AzureCliCredential or DefaultAzureCredential — simulator accepts any

help: Use AzureResourceManager.authenticate() with a profile that points HttpClient at the simulator.
Real conformance test in tests/conformance/azure-sdk-java/ proves armcompute/armstorage/armsql/armservicebus/armcosmos round-trip.
Pass $host option to each management client constructor.
Use DefaultAzureCredential — simulator accepts any token.
Pass base_url to each management client constructor.
Use DefaultAzureCredential — simulator accepts any token.

terraform.note: Vyomi's Terraform workflow (core/terraform_export.py) covers the aws and google providers only. Provision Azure resources with az CLI / the ARM SDKs pointed at http://127.0.0.1:9000.
